claim_policy: 2.0 promotion and public one-prompt performance claims remain blocked until all ten gates are pass with current repository evidence.

gates.requirement: Natural-language Autopilot routing and npm-installed Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor parity pass without task-specific setup.
gates.current_boundary: An offline npm tarball consumer install, four-channel doctor self-test, and installed-helper clean-dir mission reached HANDOFF with zero provider/model/Cursor calls.

gates.requirement: Required authority questions are not skipped, unnecessary questions are not asked, and unsupported external-brand facts block.
gates.current_boundary: Six installed-helper perturbations deterministically cover reuse, establish, refresh, surface-local-only, one-batch interview, and exact-brand blocker outcomes.

gates.requirement: Every scheduled task produces a parseable, provenance-complete DESIGN.md whose deterministic proof and implementation conformance pass.
gates.current_boundary: The validator now requires sections 1–13, resolvable evidence, an exact DESIGN.md-bound system spec with controller-computed checks, and honest sections 11–13. Provider-free canary passes; a complete scheduled model denominator does not yet exist.

gates.requirement: From-scratch scheduled UI-Resolved is at least 80 percent and at least eight of twelve tasks achieve Reliability@5.
gates.current_boundary: The latest admissible three-task Luna/high smoke sealed one of three UI-Resolved. Corrected provider-free replays identify evaluator improvements but cannot replace the sealed denominator.

gates.requirement: OmD has positive paired lift over model-only and is first or statistically tied with the strongest eligible portable UI skill under identical prompts and controls.
gates.current_boundary: Portable arms and controls are preregistered, but the twelve-task by five-trial same-prompt qualification has not run.

gates.requirement: The locked Autopilot comparison has nonnegative task-family transfer on Luna, Terra, and Sol and a positive pooled lower confidence bound.
gates.current_boundary: The model set and effort are preregistered; no current-epoch Autopilot transfer matrix has run.

gates.requirement: OmD is non-dominated across resolved quality, authority burden, wall time, and token use.
gates.current_boundary: Autonomy tracing and cost fields are specified, but the controlled competitor matrix needed for a Pareto claim is absent.

gates.requirement: Twelve greenfield task families and six authority perturbations are calibrated with two structurally distinct valid implementations and targeted mutants.
gates.current_boundary: Current task, adapter, and evaluator hashes pass provider-zero replay across 24 valid oracle cells and 72 targeted mutant cells; this is evaluator evidence, not model or skill performance evidence.

gates.requirement: Five practitioners blindly review both ship preference and design-system quality with ties, both-fail, and order reversal controls.
gates.current_boundary: Review infrastructure exists, but the new Autopilot greenfield panel has not been observed.

gates.requirement: Packages are reproducible, all outcomes downloadable and hash-bound, an independent task audit is below five percent broken or ambiguous, and claim policy is enforced.
gates.current_boundary: The package/install path and claim boundary are deterministic. The complete Autopilot outcome package and independent audit of the new hidden denominator remain outstanding.
